title: Concept: File access built from input (go) — review required
description: In go, os.Opens*([^)]*+ assembles a filesystem path from parts. Traversal payloads (..%2f, absolute paths, symlink races) redirect the operation outside its directory. The go-specific remedy is confinement via filepath evaluation plus prefix check.
applicability: go codebases opening files with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write when untrusted input reaches the path; HIGH severity because traversal payloads are trivial and impact is filesystem-wide.
